cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.12)
list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cmake")
include(CheckCXXSourceCompiles)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR})
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR})

# Automatically prepare compiler_commands
if(DEFINED ENV{CI})
    message("Running in CI. Skipping EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS")
else()
    set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
    # Only copy compile_commands.json if it exists (generated by Ninja/Makefiles)
    if(CMAKE_GENERATOR STREQUAL "Ninja" OR CMAKE_GENERATOR MATCHES "Makefiles")
        add_custom_target(copy-compile-commands ALL
            ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
            ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/compile_commands.json
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}
        )
    endif()
endif()

project(SatDump)

option(BUILD_GUI "Build the GUI" ON)
option(BUILD_TESTING "Build the testing program" OFF)
option(BUILD_TOOLS "Build the tools programs" OFF)
option(SATDUMP_TESTS "Fork: build the tests in tests/ (run them with tests/gate.sh)" OFF)
option(BUILD_ZIQ "Build support for the custom ZIQ format" ON)
option(BUILD_ZIQ2 "Build support for the custom ZIQ2 format (Very WIP)" OFF)
option(BUILD_OPENCL "Build with OpenCL GPU Accelerations" ON)
option(BUILD_OPENMP "Build with OpenMP Optimizations" ON)
option(BUILD_DOCS "Build with Doxygen Documentation" OFF)
option(ENABLE_INSTALL "Enable INSTALL TARGET" ON)
option(ENABLE_I18N "Enable internationalizaton (allows changing language)" ON)
option(ENABLE_CRASHDUMP "Enable crashdump feature (requires libcpptrace or libbacktrace)" ON)
include(cmake/fork/package_paths.cmake)

# I18N
if(ENABLE_I18N)
    add_compile_definitions(ENABLE_I18N=1)
endif()

if(ANDROID)
    # Build settings
    set(BUILD_OPENMP OFF)
    set(OPENCL_FOUND 1)
endif()

# Set default install prefix
include(GNUInstallDirs) #Retruns good defaults on non-GNU systems as well
if(UNIX)
    if(CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX_INITIALIZED_TO_DEFAULT)
        if(APPLE)
            set(CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX /usr/local CACHE PATH "Set CMAKE Default to /usr/local" FORCE)
        else()
            set(CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX /usr CACHE PATH "Set CMAKE Default to /usr" FORCE)
        endif()
    endif(CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX_INITIALIZED_TO_DEFAULT)
endif()

# Fork: a relocatable install (cmake/fork/pi.cmake turns it on). Programs in <prefix>/bin and
# plugins in <libdir>/satdump/plugins find libsatdump_core, and plugins find the plugins they
# build on (such as libxrit_support), wherever the install is unpacked.
option(SATDUMP_RELOCATABLE "Fork: installed files find their libraries relative to themselves" OFF)
if(SATDUMP_RELOCATABLE)
    set(CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN/../${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR};$ORIGIN/../..;$ORIGIN")
endif()

if(APPLE)
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -std=c++17")

    # Jemalloc
    find_package(Jemalloc REQUIRED)
    include_directories(${JEMALLOC_INCLUDE_DIR})
    link_libraries(${JEMALLOC_LIBRARY})

    # Manually built dependencies
    link_directories(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/deps/lib)
    include_directories("${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/deps/include")

    # Homebrew path is different on Silicon-based and Intel-based MacOS
    if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "arm64")
        link_directories(/opt/homebrew/lib)
        set(CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH "/opt/homebrew/;${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/deps")
        link_directories(/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/lib/) # omp needs special handling as it is not in /lib
    else()
        link_directories(/usr/local/lib)
        set(CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH "/usr/local/;${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/deps")
        link_directories(/usr/local/opt/libomp/lib/) # omp needs special handling as it is not in /lib
       
    endif()

    # Rpaths are stripped when we are going to bundle, done to prevent duplicate LC_PATH crap
    if(BUNDLING_MODE)
        set(CMAKE_SKIP_RPATH FALSE)
        set(CMAKE_BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH TRUE) 
        set(CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH "@executable_path/../libs")
        set(CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH_USE_LINK_PATH FALSE)
    endif()
endif()

if(UNIX)
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -Wall -Wextra")

    # Fork: warnings that are real bugs are errors: a throw that can only end in std::terminate
    # (in a destructor or other noexcept code), a function that can end without returning its
    # value, a shift by at least the width of its type, a switch on a bool, an ignored result
    # that must be used (such as std::remove_if, or write() under _FORTIFY_SOURCE, which Ubuntu's
    # GCC turns on), and a pointer to a member of a packed struct that may be unaligned. The Pi
    # build has none of these left, with or without _FORTIFY_SOURCE. Each flag is added only if
    # the compiler knows it (clang has no -Wterminate; its -Wexceptions also covers other cases).
    include(CheckCXXCompilerFlag)
    foreach(_satdump_werror terminate return-type shift-count-overflow switch-bool unused-result address-of-packed-member)
        string(MAKE_C_IDENTIFIER "SATDUMP_HAS_WERROR_${_satdump_werror}" _satdump_werror_var)
        check_cxx_compiler_flag("-Werror=${_satdump_werror}" ${_satdump_werror_var})
        if(${_satdump_werror_var})
            set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -Werror=${_satdump_werror}")
        endif()
    endforeach()

    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG} -g")
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE} -O3")

    if(ENABLE_CRASHDUMP)
        set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE} -g")
        # Fork: include the bundled C libraries in Linux debug-symbols packages too.
        # Keep Release optimisation flags unchanged; -g only adds debug information.
        if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
            set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE} -g")
        endif()
    endif()

    if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
        set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -Wno-psabi")
    endif()

    if(BUILD_OPENMP)
        message("Compiling with OpenMP support!")
        if(APPLE)
            set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -Wno-unused-command-line-argument -Xpreprocessor")
        endif()
        set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -fopenmp")
    endif()

    find_package(ZSTD)

    if((NOT ZSTD_FOUND) AND BUILD_ZIQ AND (NOT ANDROID))
        message("ZIQ Was enabled but libzstd was not found!")
        set(BUILD_ZIQ OFF)
    endif()
else()
    # set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "-Wall")
    # set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG "-g")
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE "-O2")
endif()

if(MSVC)
    add_compile_definitions(
        _SILENCE_ALL_CXX17_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS
        _USE_MATH_DEFINES
        _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS
        _WINSOCK_DEPRECATED_NO_WARNINGS
        _CRT_NONSTDC_NO_WARNINGS
    )

    if(BUILD_OPENMP)
        message("Compiling with OpenMP support!")
        set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} /openmp")
        set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} /openmp")
    endif()

    # This should be the default, but sometimes it isn't apparently
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE} /MD /Z7")
    set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE} /MD /Z7")
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG} /MDd")
    set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG} /MDd")
    set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS_RELEASE} /DEBUG /OPT:REF /OPT:ICF /INCREMENTAL:NO")
    set(CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS_RELEASE} /DEBUG /OPT:REF /OPT:ICF /INCREMENTAL:NO")

    # Speed up this to object-level, Suppress type conversion warnings, suppress
    # POSIX function warnings, suppress warnings about DLL-exported functions, and
    # Suppress warnings about template methods defined in another C++ file
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} /MP8 /EHsc /wd4305 /wd4267 /wd4244 /wd4273 /wd4661")
    set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} /MP8 /EHsc /wd4305 /wd4267 /wd4244 /wd4273 /wd4661")

    #Suppress pointless (to us) warnings about DLL-exported functions
    set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} /ignore:4286,4217")
    set(CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS} /ignore:4286,4217")
    set(CMAKE_STATIC_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_STATIC_LINKER_FLAGS} /ignore:4286,4217")

    set(CMAKE_WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS ON)
    include_directories(windows/deps/output/include)
    link_directories(windows/deps/output/lib)
    link_directories(windows/deps/output/bin)
endif()

# Fork: give every Linux program and shared library a stable GNU build-id, including
# plugins, so CPack can put separate debug symbols where debuggers find them by that id.
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
    foreach(_satdump_linker EXE SHARED MODULE)
        string(APPEND CMAKE_${_satdump_linker}_LINKER_FLAGS " -Wl,--build-id=sha1")
    endforeach()
endif()

# Fork: CPU tuning for both C and C++. Outside CI the default tunes for the build machine.
# To build on one machine for another, set it, e.g. -DSATDUMP_CPU_FLAGS=-mcpu=cortex-a76 (Pi 5).
# An empty value gives a portable build.
if((NOT DEFINED ENV{CI}) AND NOT DEFINED ANDROID AND (APPLE OR UNIX))
    set(SATDUMP_CPU_FLAGS_DEFAULT "-march=native")
else()
    set(SATDUMP_CPU_FLAGS_DEFAULT "")
endif()
set(SATDUMP_CPU_FLAGS "${SATDUMP_CPU_FLAGS_DEFAULT}" CACHE STRING "CPU flags added to C and C++ (empty for a portable build)")
if(SATDUMP_CPU_FLAGS)
    message("-- CPU flags: ${SATDUMP_CPU_FLAGS} (binaries may not run on other CPUs)")
    set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} ${SATDUMP_CPU_FLAGS}")
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} ${SATDUMP_CPU_FLAGS}")
endif()

# Fork: test builds with sanitizers, for example -DSATDUMP_SANITIZERS=address,undefined
set(SATDUMP_SANITIZERS "" CACHE STRING "Sanitizers to build with (testing only), e.g. address,undefined")
if(SATDUMP_SANITIZERS)
    message("-- Sanitizers: ${SATDUMP_SANITIZERS}")
    add_compile_options(-fsanitize=${SATDUMP_SANITIZERS} -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
    add_link_options(-fsanitize=${SATDUMP_SANITIZERS})
    # Index checks in the C++ library: a vector read one past its end is caught every time,
    # even when the memory behind it belongs to the vector (which AddressSanitizer allows)
    add_compile_definitions(_GLIBCXX_ASSERTIONS)
endif()

project(SatDump VERSION "2.0.0")
set(SATDUMP_VERSION_TYPE "alpha")

# Fork: libFuzzer harnesses (tests/fuzz). Clang only; use with SATDUMP_SANITIZERS and SATDUMP_TESTS.
option(SATDUMP_FUZZ "Fork: build the fuzz harnesses in tests/fuzz (clang only)" OFF)
if(SATDUMP_FUZZ)
    if(NOT CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "SATDUMP_FUZZ needs clang: -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++")
    endif()
    # Coverage feedback for libFuzzer in all of SatDump; the harnesses add the fuzzer itself
    add_compile_options(-fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link)
endif()

# Check if the current commit has a tag
execute_process(
    COMMAND git name-rev --name-only --tags HEAD
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}
    OUTPUT_VARIABLE GIT_HAS_TAG
    OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
)

# Get the current branch
execute_process(
    COMMAND git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}
    OUTPUT_VARIABLE GIT_HAS_BRANCH
    OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
)

# Get the latest abbreviated commit hash of current branch
execute_process(
    COMMAND git log -1 --format=%h
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}
    OUTPUT_VARIABLE GIT_HASH
    OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
)

# Set version
if(GIT_HAS_TAG STREQUAL "undefined" OR GIT_HAS_TAG STREQUAL "nightly")
    message("-- Commit has no tag/nightly tag (${GIT_HAS_TAG}). Assume dev build")
    if(NOT SATDUMP_VERSION_TYPE STREQUAL "")
        set(SATDUMP_VERSION "${PROJECT_VERSION}-${SATDUMP_VERSION_TYPE}-${GIT_HASH}")
    else()
        set(SATDUMP_VERSION "${PROJECT_VERSION}-${GIT_HASH}")
    endif()
else()
    message("-- Commit has tag (${GIT_HAS_TAG}). Assume release build")
    if(NOT SATDUMP_VERSION_TYPE STREQUAL "")
        set(SATDUMP_VERSION "${PROJECT_VERSION}")
    else()
        set(SATDUMP_VERSION "${PROJECT_VERSION}-${SATDUMP_VERSION_TYPE}")
    endif()
endif()

# Set branch
if(GIT_HAS_BRANCH STREQUAL "master")
    set(SATDUMP_VERSION_TAG "")
else()
    set(SATDUMP_VERSION_TAG "${GIT_HAS_BRANCH}/${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}")
endif()

    string(LENGTH "${SATDUMP_PACKAGE_SOURCE_ROOT}/" SOURCE_PATH_SIZE)
else()
    string(LENGTH "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/" SOURCE_PATH_SIZE)
endif()
add_compile_definitions(SOURCE_PATH_SIZE=${SOURCE_PATH_SIZE})

# Check system has <filesystem>
check_cxx_source_compiles("#include <filesystem>\n int main() { return 0; }" STD_HAS_FILESYSTEM)

if(NOT STD_HAS_FILESYSTEM)
    include_directories(std_filesystem)
endif()

# Install configuration
if((NOT ANDROID) AND ENABLE_INSTALL)
    install(DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/resources DESTINATION share/satdump)
    install(FILES ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/satdump_cfg.json DESTINATION share/satdump)
    install(FILES ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/satdump.svg DESTINATION share/icons/hicolor/scalable/apps)
    install(FILES ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/satdump.png DESTINATION share/icons/hicolor/256x256/apps)
    configure_file(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/satdump.desktop ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/satdump.desktop @ONLY)

    if(${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME} MATCHES "Linux")
        install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/satdump.desktop DESTINATION share/applications)
    endif()

    # Create uninstall target
    configure_file(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/cmake_uninstall.cmake ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cmake_uninstall.cmake @ONLY)
    add_custom_target(uninstall ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -P ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cmake_uninstall.cmake)

    # CPack Configuration
    set(CPACK_PACKAGE_NAME ${PROJECT_NAME} CACHE STRING "satdump-${PROJECT_VERSION}")
    set(CPACK_PACKAGE_DESCRIPTION_SUMMARY "A satellite data processing software" CACHE STRING "")
    set(CPACK_PACKAGE_VENDOR "SatDump")
    set(CPACK_PACKAGE_CONTACT "Aang23")

    set(CPACK_RESOURCE_FILE_LICENSE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/LICENSE")
    set(CPACK_RESOURCE_FILE_README "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/README.md")

    if(MSVC)
        set(CPACK_PACKAGING_INSTALL_PREFIX "/")
    else()
        set(CPACK_PACKAGING_INSTALL_PREFIX "/usr")
    endif()

    #set(CPACK_PACKAGE_VERSION_MAJOR ${PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR})
    #set(CPACK_PACKAGE_VERSION_MINOR ${PROJECT_VERSION_MINOR})
    #set(CPACK_PACKAGE_VERSION_PATCH ${PROJECT_VERSION_PATCH})
    set(CPACK_PACKAGE_VERSION ${SATDUMP_VERSION})

    if(MSVC)
        # Customize NSIS template
        file(READ "${CMAKE_ROOT}/Modules/Internal/CPack/NSIS.template.in" NSIS_template)
        set(CREATE_ICONS_REPLACE "  SetOutPath \"$INSTDIR\\bin\"\n@CPACK_NSIS_CREATE_ICONS@\n@CPACK_NSIS_CREATE_ICONS_EXTRA@\n  SetOutPath \"$INSTDIR\"")
        string(CONCAT INSTALLDIR_REPLACE "  InstallDir \"@CPACK_NSIS_INSTALL_ROOT@\\@CPACK_PACKAGE_INSTALL_DIRECTORY@\""
            "\n  InstallDirRegKey HKLM Software\\@CPACK_PACKAGE_VENDOR@\\@CPACK_PACKAGE_INSTALL_REGISTRY_KEY@ \"\"")
        string(REPLACE "@CPACK_NSIS_CREATE_ICONS@\n@CPACK_NSIS_CREATE_ICONS_EXTRA@" "${CREATE_ICONS_REPLACE}" NSIS_template "${NSIS_template}")
        string(REPLACE "  InstallDir \"@CPACK_NSIS_INSTALL_ROOT@\\@CPACK_PACKAGE_INSTALL_DIRECTORY@\"" "${INSTALLDIR_REPLACE}" NSIS_template "${NSIS_template}")
        file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/NSIS.template.in" "${NSIS_template}")
        set(CPACK_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")

        # Generate Installer
        set(CPACK_GENERATOR NSIS)
        set(CPACK_PACKAGE_INSTALL_DIRECTORY SatDump)
        set(CPACK_NSIS_MANIFEST_DPI_AWARE ON)
        set(CPACK_NSIS_ENABLE_UNINSTALL_BEFORE_INSTALL ON)
        set(CPACK_NSIS_MODIFY_PATH ON)
        set(CPACK_NSIS_BRANDING_TEXT "SatDump - General Purpose Satellite Data Processor")
        set(CPACK_NSIS_MUI_HEADERIMAGE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}\\\\windows\\\\installer-header.bmp")
        set(CPACK_NSIS_MUI_ICON "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}\\\\windows\\\\icon.ico")
        if(BUILD_GUI)
            set(CPACK_NSIS_INSTALLED_ICON_NAME "bin\\\\satdump-ui.exe")
            set(CPACK_PACKAGE_EXECUTABLES ${CPACK_PACKAGE_EXECUTABLES} "satdump-ui" "SatDump")
            list(APPEND CPACK_NSIS_CREATE_ICONS_EXTRA "CreateShortCut \\\"$DESKTOP\\\\SatDump.lnk\\\" \\\"$INSTDIR\\\\bin\\\\satdump-ui.exe\\\"")
            list(APPEND CPACK_NSIS_DELETE_ICONS_EXTRA "Delete \\\"$DESKTOP\\\\SatDump.lnk\\\"")
        endif()
        if(PLUGIN_REMOTE_SDR_SUPPORT)
            set(CPACK_PACKAGE_EXECUTABLES ${CPACK_PACKAGE_EXECUTABLES} "satdump_sdr_server" "SatDump SDR Server")
        endif()

        install(RUNTIME_DEPENDENCY_SET satdump_deps
            PRE_EXCLUDE_REGEXES
            "api-ms-.*"
            "ext-ms-.*"
            "^hvsifiletrust\\.dll$"
            "^pdmutilities\\.dll$"
            "^vc.*"
            "^msvcp.*"
            "^concrt.*"
            "satdump_core.dll"
            "satdump_interface.dll"
            POST_EXCLUDE_REGEXES
            ".*system32/.*\\.dll"
            DIRECTORIES
            "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/windows/deps/output/bin"
        )
    else()
        set(CPACK_GENERATOR DEB)
        set(CPACK_DEBIAN_FILE_NAME DEB-DEFAULT)
        set(CPACK_DEB_COMPONENT_INSTALL ON)
    endif()

    # Fork: the Debian package, set up on Linux only (scripts/build-deb.sh builds it,
    # tests/package/check_deb.sh checks it; macOS, which has its own app bundle, no longer
    # prints Debian settings when it configures). Upstream's package had a hand-written
    # Depends list that mixed Debian releases and even named a -dev package, so on Debian 13
    # it installed but could not run. Now dpkg-shlibdeps (package dpkg-dev) writes Depends
    # from what every program, library and plugin links against, for the release the package
    # is built on, and searches SatDump's own library and plugin folders (paths inside the
    # package) for its private libraries. The package is called satdump-fork and takes the
    # place of the upstream satdump package: apt removes that one when this one is installed.
    if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
        set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_NAME "satdump-fork")
        set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_PROVIDES "satdump")
        set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_CONFLICTS "satdump")
        set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_REPLACES "satdump")
        set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_MAINTAINER "Unofficial SatDump fork <satdump-fork@invalid>")
        set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_SECTION "hamradio")
        set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_DESCRIPTION
            "An unofficial fork of SatDump (https://github.com/SatDump/SatDump), not made or\nsupported by the SatDump project, built for a Raspberry Pi 5 weather-satellite\nstation. It replaces the satdump package.")
        set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_SHLIBDEPS ON)
        string(REGEX REPLACE "^/" "" _satdump_deb_root "${CPACK_PACKAGING_INSTALL_PREFIX}")
        set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_SHLIBDEPS_PRIVATE_DIRS
            "${_satdump_deb_root}/${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}"
            "${_satdump_deb_root}/${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/satdump/plugins")
        # Fork: the programs, libraries and plugins are stripped, and their debug information
        # goes into a second package, satdump-fork-dbgsym (satdump-fork-dbgsym_<version>_<arch>.ddeb,
        # which needs this exact version), one usr/lib/debug/.build-id/<xx>/<rest>.debug file
        # each: where gdb and debuginfod-style tools look for a file's debug information by its
        # GNU build-id (the linker gives every file one). Unstripped, the package was about 330 MiB.
        # CPack splits each file with objcopy (--only-keep-debug, then --strip-unneeded, which
        # keeps the symbols the dynamic loader and dlopen use) and reads the build-id with
        # readelf, both from binutils. The build type stays Release (-O3) with -g (see
        # ENABLE_CRASHDUMP above): RelWithDebInfo would compile with -O2 and change the
        # version tag the programs show.
        set(CPACK_DEBIAN_DEBUGINFO_PACKAGE ON)
        if(SATDUMP_PACKAGE_PATH_MAP)
            # CPack 3.31 writes absolute staging paths into dbgsym control/md5sums.
            set(CPACK_POST_BUILD_SCRIPTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/fork/dbgsym_control.cmake")
        endif()
        # Fork: dpkg-shlibdeps, the file program (which CPack uses to find the programs and
        # libraries to pass it), objcopy and readelf are checked before anything is installed,
        # and making the package stops with the Debian packages to install. Without
        # dpkg-shlibdeps CPack made a package with an empty Depends; without the others it
        # stopped only after the whole install.
        set(CPACK_PROJECT_CONFIG_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/fork/cpack_deb_tools.cmake")
        # Nothing is needed by hand: SatDump runs no other program it cannot do without, and
        # its data is in the package. Recommended: ca-certificates, for downloads over HTTPS
        # (orbital elements, Earth-orientation data). Suggested, as they are only for the GUI
        # or some radios, and some are large (zenity alone brings a desktop toolkit, about
        # 120 packages, onto a headless Pi): zenity for the GUI's file and folder dialogs,
        # xdg-utils to open links from it, an OpenCL driver for GPU speed-ups, and the USRP tools.
        set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_RECOMMENDS "ca-certificates")
        set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_SUGGESTS "zenity, xdg-utils, mesa-opencl-icd, uhd-host")

        # Fork: a Debian version that sorts by release stage, then by commit date. SatDump's
        # own version (such as 2.0.0-alpha-1aedd60) has a hyphen that Debian reads as the
        # package revision, so builds were ordered by commit hash. See
        # cmake/fork/debian_version.cmake; for example 2.0.0~alpha+git20261111.230102.44f17297f-1.
        execute_process(
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E env TZ=UTC0 git log -1 --format=%cd --date=format-local:%Y%m%d.%H%M%S
            WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}
            OUTPUT_VARIABLE _satdump_git_date
            OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
            ERROR_QUIET
        )
        include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cmake/fork/debian_version.cmake)
        satdump_debian_version(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_VERSION "${PROJECT_VERSION}" "${SATDUMP_VERSION_TYPE}" "${_satdump_git_date}" "${GIT_HASH}")
        set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_RELEASE 1)
        if(NOT CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_VERSION MATCHES "\\+git")
            message(STATUS "No git information: the Debian package version is ${CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_VERSION}-1, which sorts before every build made from a git clone")
        endif()
        message(STATUS "Debian package: ${CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_NAME} ${CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_VERSION}-${CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_RELEASE}")
    endif()

    set(CPACK_COMPONENTS_GROUPING ALL_COMPONENTS_IN_ONE)

    include(CPack)
endif()

# Doxygen configuration
if((CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE MATCHES "^[Rr]elease") AND BUILD_DOCS)
    find_package(Doxygen)
    if(DOXYGEN_FOUND)
        set(DOXYGEN_IN ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Doxyfile.in)
        set(DOXYGEN_OUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Doxyfile)
        set(DOXYGEN_FILES  "src-core/common/ccsds \
                            src-core/products \
                            src-core/handlers \
                            src-interface/explorer \
                            src-core/projection \
                            src-core/dsp \
                            src-core/image \
                            src-core/utils \
                            docs/pages \
                            docs/res \
                            plugins/xrit_support/xrit")
        set(DOXYGEN_FILES  "${DOXYGEN_FILES} \
                            plugins/fengyun2_support/fengyun2/svissr")

        configure_file(${DOXYGEN_IN} ${DOXYGEN_OUT} @ONLY)
        message("-- Doxygen build enabled!")

        add_custom_target(docs_doxygen ALL
            COMMAND ${DOXYGEN_EXECUTABLE} ${DOXYGEN_OUT}
            WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
            COMMENT "Generating API documentation with Doxygen"
            VERBATIM)

        add_custom_command(TARGET docs_doxygen POST_BUILD
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory
                    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/docs/res
                    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/documentation/html/res)
    else(DOXYGEN_FOUND)
        message("Doxygen need to be installed to generate the doxygen documentation")
    endif(DOXYGEN_FOUND)
endif()
